name: Diffit
description: Get quality supplemental resources and differentiation support for any topic, skill or standard. Just ask Claude for what you need, and Diffit generates it while you watch. Open in Diffit to edit, add activities, and print or export to your favorite tool.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Diffit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Diffit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.diffit.me/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Diffit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Diffit provides these MCP tools: create_resource and get_resource_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Diffit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Diffit in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
Diffit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Diffit is developed by Diffit. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
